assay_run.method: Library CTRL_05d. Pooled muscle-derived single-cell suspension processed using Chromium Single Cell 3′ v3 chemistry. Approximately 5,000 cells were captured; libraries were sequenced using paired-end 101-bp reads with an 8-cycle index read. Approximately 30,000 reads per cell were sequenced.

sample.biological_model: Euthyroid control mouse model of cardiotoxin-induced muscle regeneration
sample.biological_source: Tibialis anterior muscle from male Cre-negative mice carrying the reported Fucci2aR background: B6;129-Gt(ROSA)26Sor<tm1(Fucci2aR)Jkn.
sample.sample_material: Single-cell suspension pooled from tibialis anterior muscles of three male euthyroid control mice, collected 5 days after cardiotoxin injury. Mice received matched control diet TD.120461 without PTU. Donor identities and individual cell contributions were not reported.

sample.biological_model: Low-iodine/PTU-induced hypothyroid mouse model of cardiotoxin-induced muscle regeneration
sample.biological_source: Tibialis anterior muscle from male Cre-negative mice carrying the reported Fucci2aR background: B6;129-Gt(ROSA)26Sor<tm1(Fucci2aR)Jkn.
sample.sample_material: Single-cell suspension pooled from tibialis anterior muscles of three male low-iodine/PTU-treated hypothyroid mice, collected 5 days after cardiotoxin injury. Mice received iodine-deficient diet TD.08259; its exact iodine content was not reported. Donor identities and individual cell contributions were not reported.
